---
name: "AOE2 Data And Script Rules"
description: "Use when editing data JSON, icon maps, unit stats, unit lines, validators, asset sync scripts, or import scripts."
applyTo: ["scripts/**/*.mjs", "src/data/**/*.json"]
---

# Data And Script Rules

- Prefer deterministic scripts and validators over manual JSON patching for generated data.
- Keep `src/data/icon-map.json` generated by `pnpm icons:map`; do not hand-map unverified icons unless there is an explicit source.
- After asset updates, run `pnpm assets:sync`, `pnpm icons:map`, and `pnpm validate:icons` in that order.
- Unit progression data must stay consistent between `src/data/unit-lines.json` and `src/data/unit-stats.json`.
- Civilization unique-unit references should resolve to known unit slugs and expected icon handling.
- Do not make network-refresh scripts run implicitly during `pnpm build`; builds must remain predictable for Cloudflare Pages.
- For script changes, run the touched script directly when possible, then `pnpm check` and `pnpm test` if TypeScript or test-covered helpers are affected.
